verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of acting on many items at once is CSV upload: raw compliance resources and user-access-review data can be ingested in bulk. That is a bulk import, not general bulk editing, updating or deleting across existing items. The REST API and MCP server are developer building blocks for scripting such operations, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/update/delete actions across items (e.g., multi-select on controls, vendors or risks), batch API endpoints, bulk operations through the MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Push raw data via an API endpoint or CSV upload and let Secureframe handle normalization, mapping, and testing for compliance-related resources
